collocations: stipulate that... / as stipulated in the contract
tip: 多益聽力與閱讀常考商業合約條款，後面常接子句。
sentence: The contract stipulates that all deliveries must be made within 30 days.
sentenceZh: 合約規定所有交貨必須在 30 天內完成。

tip: 多益財經與企業新聞題組常客，動詞為 merge。
sentence: The proposed merger will be finalized next month.
sentenceZh: 擬議中的合併案將於下個月底定。

tip: 負責處理公司的 accounting（會計）與 financial reports。
sentence: Our chief accountant will audit the annual balance sheet.
sentenceZh: 我們的首席會計師將審核年度資產負債表。
